# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please do not open a public issue for security problems.**

Report them privately through GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/FastgramApp/Fastgram-iOS/security/advisories/new)
(Security → Report a vulnerability). Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the app
version or commit you tested.

Fastgram is maintained in someone's spare time — expect a first reply within a few days rather
than a few hours. Please give a reasonable window for a fix before disclosing publicly.

## Scope

This repository covers the Fastgram iOS client only.

Vulnerabilities in the **Telegram protocol, servers, or the official Telegram apps** should go to
Telegram's own [bug bounty programme](https://core.telegram.org/bug-bounty) instead. If the same
issue reproduces in the official Telegram for iOS app, it is an upstream issue.

## Credentials

If you find committed credentials, certificates or provisioning profiles anywhere in this
repository or its history, report it privately using the link above rather than in an issue or
pull request.
